Reservation History
Your Ledger & Audit Trail

Every Stay, Every Year

Charged nights draw from the annual allotment for the use-year in which each night falls. Short-notice nights are bonus and are never charged. Forfeited nights are charged under the cancellation policy.

Audit Trail

Every change to a reservation, balance, swap, rule or ownership record, with who made it and when. Read-only. In production this is an append-only table that nobody, including the front desk, can edit.
Front Desk Console
Residence 214 · Administration

Usage Rules

Rules in force · v1
Seasons, holidays and limits are data, not code. Change a number here and every owner's calendar, balance and error message follows. Each change is versioned and logged; a reservation always keeps the rule set it was booked under.

Owners of Residence 214

Eight 1/8 shares. Bars show nights charged this use-year against the allotment. Locking a share for delinquent dues blocks new reservations until cleared.

Ownership Transfer

Moves a share to a new owner at closing. Reservations either follow the share or are released, the remaining balance is pro-rated to the closing date, and both sides of the transfer are written to the audit trail.

Maintenance & Association Blocks

Nights that belong to no owner: deep cleans, repairs, inspections. Owners see them hatched on the calendar and cannot book over them.

Holiday First-Pick Rotation

Each marquee holiday rotates through the eight shares. The first-pick owner has an exclusive right to the holiday until 12 months before the date; after that it opens to everyone. Ties on the same second are settled by this order, never by who refreshed first.

Utilization & Fairness Report

What the association sees: nights used and reserved per share, peak-season stays and holiday weeks held, for the current use-year. Simulated for co-owners.
